adjudication.rationale: The diff shows `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve` synchronously calling `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true (lib/topic_retriever.rb). `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` downloads/parses the feed (`SimpleRSS.parse open(...)`) and iterates every item, calling `TopicEmbed.import` for each (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb), which can perform per-item DB lookups and potentially create/revise posts. This is a concrete performance/architecture concern on a single embed request and duplicates the hourly scheduled poll behavior. Also, `feed_key` is defined but never used (poll_feed.rb), supporting the finding that conditional/etag-based fetching may have been intended but not wired.
